children: WHO's Technical Advisory Group recommended Moderna's investigational mRNA-1469 vaccine for a Phase 2/3 efficacy study in the DRC, subject to regulatory approval. Phase 1 interim results showed it was generally well tolerated and generated BDBV-specific binding antibody responses.
WHO group recommends mRNA-1469 for Phase 2/3
Advances the candidate toward an efficacy study, but trial entry remains subject to regulatory approval.
Phase 1: generally well tolerated across doses
Supports continued development; the release gives no efficacy results or numerical safety data.
Single dose generated BDBV-specific antibody responses
An early immune-response finding, not evidence of clinical protection.
CEPI committed up to $58.5M to Moderna
Provides funding for specified development and dose-manufacturing work; no prior-period comparison was provided.

This is an early-stage development update, following Phase 1 results and before the proposed efficacy study. Regulatory approval and trial initiation, followed by efficacy data, would be needed to establish a larger catalyst.
